title: Full-stack web applications
short: End-to-end product development from data model to polished interface.
description: I build complete web applications with a clear architecture, maintainable components, and a strong focus on the workflows people repeat every day.
bestFor: Teams with a defined product idea that need a dependable build partner.

title: Frontend engineering & design systems
short: Accessible interfaces and reusable components that stay coherent as products grow.
description: From a new marketing site to a complex product interface, I turn design intent into semantic, responsive frontend code with patterns the whole team can reuse.
bestFor: Product teams outgrowing ad-hoc styles or preparing for a design-system investment.

title: API & database design
short: Predictable APIs and data models designed around the access patterns that matter.
description: I design and implement APIs and relational data models that are straightforward to consume, test, and operate, with attention to migrations and long-term change.
bestFor: Products with growing data complexity or teams untangling an overloaded backend.

title: Performance & technical SEO
short: Faster pages and crawlable foundations, measured against real user conditions.
description: I audit and improve loading performance, rendering stability, metadata, and crawlability, then verify the changes with before-and-after measurements.
bestFor: Sites that look fine but feel slow, or content sites that are not being discovered.

title: Accessibility audits & remediation
short: Practical accessibility improvements, prioritized by user impact.
description: I review interfaces against WCAG 2.2 AA, test with keyboard and assistive technology, and deliver a prioritized plan with implementation support rather than a generic checklist.
bestFor: Teams preparing for procurement requirements or wanting a genuinely usable product.

title: Maintenance & ongoing support
short: Steady improvements, dependency care, and a reliable partner after launch.
description: Launch is not the end. I help teams keep dependencies current, fix the right bugs, improve rough edges, and plan the next round of product work.
bestFor: Small teams with a live product but no dedicated full-time engineer.
